message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"The current best evaluated point (phase_bits=16) meets the 8-LSB quality requirement but has the largest mapped area (1584.56 um^2). The two lower-precision neighbors (12 and 14 bits) are smaller but fail the quality check, so the feasible region boundary lies between 14 and 16 bits. Decreasing precision is the only legal action that can reduce area while staying near the quality boundary; it may land on a still-feasible lower-area point or confirm that 16 bits is the minimum precision needed, giving a better area/quality tradeoff than switching architecture or interpolation, which would change the design space more drastically."}
